de_seed_rule: A DE run is made in parts that end at the validation checks: 24 generations, then four at a time. Part k (k = 0, 1, ...) starts from the stored population and calls SciPy with seed + k. The Latin-hypercube points of the initial population use the seed itself. Both geometry settings use the same seeds and the same initial populations.
measurement_noise_rule: numpy.random.default_rng(seed); normal draws with the shape of each array, in the order q, qd, imu_acc, imu_gyr, tau; noisy record = noise-free record + draw. Both geometry settings use the same seeds.
